annotations.title: Create a draft invoice (preview, then confirm)

description: Create a DRAFT customer invoice (never sent, not in the ledger until the business sends it from GetAccountED). VAT at 15% if the business is a VAT vendor. TWO STEPS: first call returns the totals + confirm_token; second call with confirm_token saves the draft. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

create_customer.description: Create the customer by customer_name if none matches

customer_name.description: Or the customer's name (must match one customer)

prices_include_vat.description: true = unit prices already include VAT; false = VAT added on top. Default: the business's invoice setting.

name: accounting_create_invoice_draft
